description: This file contains functions related to network interface configuration in the OpenWrt system, including operations such as finding configurations, fixing interface settings, scanning and setting up network interfaces, and executing system controls.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds the network interface configuration matching a specified device.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Executes an ubus call and loads the JSON response.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts interface settings based on its type and current status.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and applies fixup to all interfaces.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Sets up a network interface with a specified configuration.

methods.name: do_sysctl
methods.description: Sets or gets system control variables.
